meta.parties: Fernando Et Al v. Alwis Et Al

rules.statement: A deed of gift creating a fidei commissum must have a valid acceptance to be effective, and the terms of such a deed should not be construed to create multiple separate fidei commissa unless explicitly stated.
rules.supporting_quote: "The defendants also contended that the deed of gift created not one fidei commissum but five separate fidei commissa and that the plaintiffs did not succeed to the share of any of the donees who died without issue or without issue in the male line. In the alternative that if the deed created one fidei commissum the plaintiffs had no interest in the property donated as long as Marthinus was alive."
